info.name: Expent API Collection (Render)
info.description: Comprehensive Postman API Collection for testing the live Expent Backend on Render. Includes headers, sample request payloads, and pre-saved success/error response examples.

request.description: Bypasses Google OAuth verification for easy testing. Returns user profile along with access and refresh tokens.
